newsitem.title: USA: CRW Financial stake upped by Fir Tree.
newsitem.headline: CRW Financial stake upped by Fir Tree.

text.p: A group including Fir Tree Partners said Thursday it raised its stake in CRW Financial Inc to 453,703 common shares or 7.71 percent from six percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York-based investment group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 100,500 common shares between June 2 and June 16 at prices ranging from $8.3125 to $8.7010 per share.
The group said it holds the shares in the King of Prussia, Pa.,-based company for investment purposes.
